name: Fathom
tagline: AI meeting partner that records and summarises calls
description: Fathom records and transcribes calls and produces instant AI summaries, with a free plan and paid plans for individuals and teams.
features: Unlimited recordings and transcriptions on the Free plan
Choice of bot-free (beta) or bot capture
Clips, playlists and search across calls
useCases: Recording and summarising sales or client calls
Searching what was said across past calls
strengths: A free-forever plan with unlimited recordings
A 90-day guarantee is listed on every plan
limitations: The pricing page did not make clear which listed price is monthly and which is annual
Some features are marked limited use without saying which plan they apply to

free.details: Free forever: unlimited recordings and transcriptions, bot-free (beta) or bot capture, instant AI call summaries, clips, playlists and search across calls.

plans.name: Premium
plans.note: $20 and $16 per user per month are both shown; the page does not say which is monthly billing and which is annual

plans.name: Team
plans.note: $19 and $15 per user per month are both shown, 2 users minimum; which is monthly and which is annual is not stated

plans.name: Business
plans.note: $34 and $25 per user per month are both shown, 2 users minimum; which is monthly and which is annual is not stated

pricing.regional: Prices were shown with a '$' sign and no currency code. A toggle says annual billing saves 25% or more.

verification.notes: Product active. The page shows Free $0; Premium $16; Team $15 and Business $25 per user/month (Team and Business need 2 users); Enterprise by sales. The pricing toggle (Monthly / Annually, save 25%+) could not be switched, so the page text does not say which billing period these figures belong to; an earlier check also saw $20, $19 and $34. Kept partial.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

keyFeature: Records and transcribes calls with instant AI summaries

profile.headline: An AI notetaker that records and summarises your meetings, with or without a bot

capabilities.title: Capture notes your way
capabilities.text: Take notes with or without a bot joining the call.

capabilities.title: Get summaries shortly after a call
capabilities.text: AI summaries are ready soon after the meeting ends.

capabilities.title: Search what was said
capabilities.text: Searchable transcripts keep action items, key moments and context for later.

capabilities.title: Ask across past conversations
capabilities.text: Ask Fathom searches earlier calls and gives summaries tailored to your team's priorities.

featureCards.name: Topic monitoring
featureCards.text: Automatically tracks key topics so critical moments are not missed.

featureCards.name: AI Scorecards
featureCards.text: Follow-up metrics and real-time coaching moments.

featureCards.name: App integrations
featureCards.text: Works with Google Meet, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Gmail, Slack, Asana, Salesforce, HubSpot and Notion.

featureCards.name: Automatic syncing
featureCards.text: Notes and action items sync to the connected tools.

featureCards.name: API, MCP and Zapier
featureCards.text: A public API and MCP, plus a Zapier integration.

featureCards.name: Security
featureCards.text: The site lists SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, HIPAA compliance and SSO with SCIM.

audienceDetail.text: The page frames it around clarity, momentum and ease for one person.
Shared visibility into customer conversations, internal syncs and strategy calls.
Capture context, update the CRM and surface risks and opportunities.
Interview evaluation, and tracking feature requests and satisfaction.

scenarios.title: Update the CRM after a sales call
scenarios.text: Capture the context and sync notes automatically.

scenarios.title: Spot churn risk
scenarios.text: Surface risks and trends across customer conversations.

scenarios.title: Track marketing sentiment
scenarios.text: Watch for changes in how users talk about the product.

gettingStarted.text: Use the Get started button on the homepage.
Select the option for your team, which leads to the team sign-in.
